headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 7, 2026**
article:
The Los Angeles Angels secured a 4-1 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Mitch Farris earning the win. Zach Neto led the Angels' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. In other action, the Cincinnati Reds edged out the Athletics 6-5, while the New York Mets dominated the Cleveland Guardians 13-6. The Milwaukee Brewers snapped the Pittsburgh Pirates' winning streak with a 5-2 victory.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, including Tampa Bay Rays second baseman Ben Williamson, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain. The Seattle Mariners, Minnesota Twins, Cleveland Guardians, Chicago White Sox, and Toronto Blue Jays have also made moves to address injuries.

The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their lineup with the acquisition of first baseman Jacob Berry in a trade with the Miami Marlins. The Athletics also made a trade, acquiring right-hander Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies. The Miami Marlins traded right-hander Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for a package of players, and the Colorado Rockies traded right-hander Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for a pair of players.

top_news.title: **Angels Take Down Orioles 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels secured a 4-1 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Mitch Farris earning the win. Zach Neto led the Angels' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Athletics in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Athletics 6-5 in a closely contested game. Seth Johnson led the Athletics' pitching staff with 2.0 IP, 4 K, 1 ER, 0 BB, 3 H.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Guardians in Thrilling 13-6 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets dominated the Cleveland Guardians, securing a 13-6 win. Luis Torrens led the Mets' offense with a strong performance, recording 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Brewers Take Down Pirates in 5-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers secured a 5-2 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates, snapping their opponent's winning streak. Gary Sánchez led the Pirates' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Rays Place Williamson on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays second baseman Ben Williamson has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain, effective retroactive to August 6, 2026. Williamson's status will be reassessed after the 10-day period.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals' roster as part of a trade.
